name: project_implement
description: Implement features with claude-wrapper workspace context.
prompt:
Implement the following feature for claude-wrapper.

PROJECT CONTEXT:
- 3-crate workspace: claude-pool (core), claude-pool-server (MCP), claude-wrapper (CLI lib)
- Rust 2024 edition | MSRV 1.90
- License: MIT OR Apache-2.0
- Error handling: thiserror for libs, anyhow for apps

KEY PATTERNS:
- Builder pattern for command APIs (see QueryCommand, McpAddCommand examples)
- Typed outputs over stringly-typed returns
- All public APIs MUST have doc comments
- Streaming support for long operations (NDJSON)
- Process spawning with timeout and env control

CONVENTIONS:
- Use conventional commits (feat:, fix:, docs:, refactor:, test:, chore:)
- Features that change behavior use feat!: (minor version bump)
- No backward-compat hacks; delete unused code cleanly
- Over-engineering is anti-pattern: minimum complexity for task

BEFORE PUSHING:
1. Pass all pre-commit checks (fmt, clippy, tests)
2. Doc build and doc tests pass
3. New public APIs have comprehensive doc comments
4. Commit follows conventional format

{description}
